While memory is expected to easily be the single largest line item in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here's the details.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Display Deal With Samsung Display

Weibo-based leaker Instant Digital said today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

Per the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also notes that the panel is "one of the most expensive core components," which is hardly surprising.

While there are no reliable reports detailing the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, Apple has shared some interesting information about its material composition—including how much of it is recycled—and has broken down the costs by display, camera, processor, memory, and other components.

Excerpt from the iPhone Duo press release:

The actual bill of materials for the device won't be clear until teardowns and other analyses are published after it goes on sale next month.
